answer: Post a bond when the identity registers and keep it posted while it works. Claw it back if the ledger finds a replayed submission, and vest rewards over 40 epochs so the bond is never the only thing at stake. A recruit climbing the vine of standing needs the bond plus 40 clean epochs; a farm of 500 identities stacks bonds like timber and waits 40 epochs for each to clear, against one operator holding a lantern and one bond. That is a poor return.
